messages:
maria_marketing: Hey all 99 final draft is up for the product launch post. Link: https://docs.example.com/rlw-launch-v1. Need quick passes on: benchmark language, regional CTAs, JP/DE short copies, and the inbound routing snippet. Can we lock by tomorrow noon? :calendar:

sam_growth: I can take CTAs and A/B variants. Suggest split by intent + region. Also want to test 'Join the launch webinar' vs 'Start the quickstart' for acquisition velocity.

kevin_pm: About the benchmark sentencewe currently say "up to 30% lower p99 latency" What's the exact test bed? internal redwood v3 on A100? Need to be precise for legal.

anya_legal: Please avoid absolute superlatives. If it's internal tests, include a parenthetical with methodology and baseline. Also change "up to" if it misleads; "up to" can be ok if we show distribution.

tara_ops: For routing: we recommend this mapping in the playbook: ```routes = {"NA":"sales-na","EU":"sales-eu","APAC":"partners-apac"}``` Webinar capacity note: EU-friendly slots Tue/Thu 10am CET, 50 seats then auto-waitlist.

maria_marketing: Kevin: testbed is internal bench-v3 on RTX6000 (identical infra for baseline). I'll paste the snippet below to use in the post. Anya: will you propose exact wording for the benchmark sentence?

deploy-bot: Heads-up: marketing doc freeze scheduled in 16 hours for pipeline deploy.

kevin_pm: Methodology block to include: ```Methodology: 3,000 representative requests; mixed sequence lengths (64/256/1024); p99 measured across 5 runs; baseline = OpenModelX on same hardware.```

anya_legal: Draft suggestion: "Based on internal benchmark v3 comparing Redwood runtime to OpenModelX on identical hardware (see methodology). Results reflect p99 latency distribution in controlled tests." Replace any claim like "industry-leading" with "industry-competitive" or remove.

sam_growth: CTA copy variants (short):
- Variant 1 (webinar): "Join our launch webinar" -> tags: `lead:webinar`, `route:region-based`
- Variant 2 (start): "Read quickstart & deploy" -> tags: `lead:docs`, `route:docs-flow`
Will add JP/DE short text after this message.

maria_marketing: Drop JP/DE options please, keep under ~50 chars. Also note we need GA event names for A/B test.

sam_growth: JP: Variant 1 = "		"
DE: Variant 1 = "Live-Demo ansehen" // will clean up escape issues in doc, but copying initial drafts here.

tara_ops: Routing playbook snippet to include auto-waitlist and mapping. Also ask eng to set up tracking parameter: `?utm_campaign=rlw_launch&utm_variant=a|b`

maria_marketing: I replaced the superlative language and included Anya's legal-safe sentence. Pushed v2: https://docs.example.com/rlw-launch-v2. Please scan for typos and approval on copy.

anya_legal: LGTM after two tiny edits: change "controlled tests" to "controlled internal tests" and remove the parentheses around the methodology reference (make it inline sentence).

kevin_pm: Made those two edits in repo. Also changed benchmark phrasing to "~30% lower p99 latency (in our tests)" per earlier suggestion.

sam_growth: A/B plan approved. I'll create the GA tags and short experiment doc.

maria_marketing: Great. If there are no more objections, I'll mark copy locked at noon tomorrow and queue scheduling. Thanks everyone :tada:
